title: Conscious content is maximally decodable in posterior cortex

statements.text: In the Cogitate adversarial test, IIT predicted that conscious content is decoded best from posterior brain areas, with no necessary role for prefrontal cortex.

sources.quote: For prediction 1 (decoding of conscious content), IIT predicts maximal decoding of conscious content in posterior brain areas, whereas GNWT emphasizes a necessary role for the PFC.
